name: Dark Orchid
lede: Dark Orchid is a vivid purple from the X11 color list, one of the standard named colors of the web.

sections.title: A listed color
sections.body:
Paterson's dictionary lists DarkOrchid as an entry in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code 9932CC [1]. In his index of colour names it is filed with the violets, next to DarkViolet [2]. The records we hold place the name in the CSS list and in a web encyclopedia, and give no earlier source [3]. Where the name came from is undocumented in our sources, so we do not guess at it.

Its nearest neighbors among our names, by CIELAB distance, are [[vivid-violet|Vivid violet]], [[vivid-violet|Violet (RYB)]] and [[bright-lavender|Lightish Purple]] [5]. On a white page it reaches a contrast ratio of 5.7:1 [5].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our archive of 23,781 paintings has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of this swatch covering at least 1% of its canvas, as photographed [4]. That describes the archive, not painting as a whole, and it says nothing against the color: it is a screen color first, and museum photographs rarely hold it.

origin.source: Paterson, A Dictionary of Colour, p. 141
